scale.basis: Flat-pattern views give 120 x 95.4. Hole chains come from the main view and Details A/B. Sheet thickness is not given; 1 mm is assumed.

frame: Web plate in XY with Z up and the plate occupying z 0..1. X=0 is the left edge. Y=0 is the line through the bottom corner hole centres (the drawing's datum), so the top corner holes sit at y=75.4. Flanges bend up (+Z) at bend lines y=3.9 and y=70.8. The centre tabs bend down (-Z).
body: web plate 120 x 66.9 x 1 spanning y 3.9..70.8
flat corner wings x 0..18 and x 108.5..120 spanning y -2.1..77.4, t=1
bottom flanges at y 3.9..4.9: x 18..65.1 and x 76..108, height 14.4 (+Z)
top flanges at y 69.8..70.8: same x ranges, height 14.4 (+Z)
centre tabs x 66.4..74.7 at the bottom and top bend lines, 14.4 deep (-Z)
guessed: Hole diameters were scaled from the views.
Bend line positions (3.9, 70.8) and the corner-wing extent were scaled from the flat view.
Tab bend direction (-Z) was read from the iso view.
R2 corner radii and relief slits are omitted.
